name: Band Row
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a resistance band around your feet, holding the ends with your arms extended.
Sit tall and pull the band toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start with your arms straight.
Do not lean back to finish the rep.
image_prompt_scene: Seated on the floor with the legs extended, a band around the feet and the arms extended.
